_readme: Drop royalty-free audio files into public/audio/music/ and describe them here.
Every field matters: `moods` is matched against the AI director's requested mood,
`licence` is what makes a shipped video auditable. Keep it honest — if a track's
licence does not permit commercial social use, it does not belong in this file.
Good free sources: Pixabay Music (Content License), Free Music Archive (CC),
Uppbeat and Epidemic Sound (paid, but their licences cover client work).
An empty `tracks` array is fine: videos render without music and the job
